purpose: Proposed semantic decisions for artifact projection from authority

decisions.statement: Projection requires all mandatory authority layers (semantic, ontology, context, data); missing layers block projection with explicit AUTHORITY_INCOMPLETE error
If optional authority layers are missing, projection proceeds with defaults; defaults are explicit in the output
Projection is atomic: either all artifacts are generated or none; partial projection is not returned
Each projected artifact includes the source authority version and projection timestamp for traceability
Running projection twice on the same authority and inputs must produce byte-for-byte identical artifacts

projectionStrategy.schemaValidation: Validate projected artifact against authority-defined JSON schema
projectionStrategy.defaultGeneration: Generate sensible defaults for unspecified optional fields
projectionStrategy.conflictResolution: Explicit conflicts fail projection; implicit choices are documented

failureHandling.handlingStrategy: Report which authority document is missing; list available authorities
Report validation errors; do not attempt recovery; require manual authority correction
Report which authority layer is missing; list what is required for projection
Report conflicting projections; require explicit choice or authority revision

nextSteps: Analyze existing projectors to extract projection semantics
